verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage ships its own agentic workflows (screening and transaction monitoring agents), so asking whether users can plug in external MCP servers is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents any MCP client support or a way to attach external tool servers. The llms.txt file, the OpenAPI schema, and the configurable agent settings are documentation or API surfaces, not MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
